initial_scope: Five frames per fixed failed road: Gironde, Alsace and the previously evaluated Bourges train case; all five frozen regions each.
controls: Reuse exact cached converged homography and metric_free results from sequence_v5/sequence_v1 or benchmark_v3 Bourges. Verify identical masks and policy counts, retain hashes.
model_admission: Pinned local checkpoint, installed source/package checks, MPS only, passed actual-model translation and excluded-pixel correspondence-invariance certificate. No implicit download.
registration: Sanitize all excluded source and target RGB before matching, fitting and photometric audits. Original hidden target RGB enters only scoring after registration returns.
geometry_and_fusion: Unchanged propose_edge, fit_graph, fit_metric_graph, audit_poses, convex-hull support, convergence rejection and benchmark_v2 policy thresholds.
resumption: Immutable execution plan; source/model/mask hashes in pair cache; donor-only matches reused across regions. Existing different output must be versioned, never overwritten.
spatial_validation: Four source-image quadrant holdouts per proposed pair are diagnostics only. Random correspondence holdout and donor agreement are not calibrated correctness estimates.
measurements: same accepted pixels RGB error against each cached control
limitations: Actual footprint has no ground truth
No gradient comparison on common accepted pixels because old controls do not retain predicted RGB
Known-translation model check does not settle absolute pixel-center convention
Bourges is training data and repeatedly used roads are development
No default promotion from this experiment
